purpose: Run a genuinely untouched backward historical transportability test of the V2.8.3 CALM risk-compression mechanism on a time interval never consumed by V2.8.1/V2.8.2, without claiming restoration of the lost V2.7.3 strategy.

holdout.last_eligible_signal_date: latest frozen joint trading date whose D+10 endpoint also lies on or before 2024-12-31

population.membership_rule: official_list_date <= D < official_delist_date, with blank delist open-ended
population.survivor_bias_control: Current active plus frozen official delisted A-share intervals are retained.
population.sampling_frame: All canonical securities whose official membership interval intersects 2023-01-01 through 2024-12-31.

factor_semantics.rv10_over_rv60: Same V2.8.3 definition: population std of latest 10 daily log close returns through D divided by latest 60, finite positive denominator required.
factor_semantics.tr10_over_tr60: Same V2.8.3 true-range-percent 10/60 mean ratio definition using only rows through D.
factor_semantics.market_state: Same V2.8.3 CSI300 rule: CALM iff CSI300 rv10/rv60 <= 1; STRESSED otherwise; UNKNOWN when warmup is insufficient.

statistical_mechanics.within_date_metric: Spearman factor rank versus forward return across sampled PIT-eligible securities.
statistical_mechanics.quarter_stability: positive CALM direction-adjusted D+10 mean IC in at least two-thirds of valid quarters and every leave-one-valid-quarter-out mean remains >0

decision_states.V2_8_5_BACKWARD_HOLDOUT_REPLICATED_BOTH: Both H1 and H2 satisfy all frozen transportability conditions.
decision_states.V2_8_5_BACKWARD_HOLDOUT_PARTIAL: Exactly one satisfies all frozen conditions.
decision_states.V2_8_5_BACKWARD_HOLDOUT_REJECTED: Minimum information is sufficient and neither satisfies all conditions.
decision_states.V2_8_5_BACKWARD_HOLDOUT_INCOMPLETE: Frozen minimum information is not met.
decision_states.V2_8_5_BACKWARD_HOLDOUT_BLOCKED: Source, identity, PIT, calendar or implementation integrity prevents evaluation.

promotion_effect.replicated_both: May advance to a separately frozen V2.8.6 Setup-design study.
promotion_effect.partial: Research evidence only; no automatic Setup design authorization.
promotion_effect.rejected: Do not build a Setup around the CALM risk-compression mechanism.
promotion_effect.all_states: No Setup, Episode, First60, or live authorization.

forbidden: No inspection-driven change to sample rule, CALM threshold, factors, directions, horizon, bootstrap, multiplicity or pass conditions.
No use of 2023-2024 outcomes to modify the V2.8.3 prospective contract.
No claim that V2.8.5 restores V2.7.3.
